permits.description: as built - revision to pa # 202403198139 - upgrade matrix (added door holder function to the sequence of operation matrix). due to unit layout correction, cfp added one low frequency notification device to one unit.

as built to pa# 202403198139: a low frequency removed. the elevator checklist revised. shunt trip has bene removed from elevator/machine room. 4 repeater removed. sequence of operation revised. 1 annunciator added.

upgrade to (e) fire alarm devices to be replaced to include manual pull stations & smoke detectors. (e) bells to be replaced with horn/strobes & strobes. units to have 520hz lf audibles installed. fire alarm control panel shall be monitored with a starlink 24v cell gms-sole path communication.
re-tile bathroom shower & wall. bathroom floor, vanity top

work in one unit: replace kitchen cabinetry, countertops, appliances and tile backsplash. no change in wall and opening layout. a min. of 50%mof the total wattage of permanently installed lighting in kitchen shall be high efficiency.
